final: WITH g AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS inv, c.Company AS comp, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS ap, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Company), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.comp, g.ap, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.tot AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.tot IS NOT NULL), co AS (SELECT comp, AVG(ap) AS ap, SUM(cnt) AS tc, AVG(share) AS sh FROM s GROUP BY comp) SELECT AVG(ap), AVG(tc), AVG(sh) FROM co
